description: Supply Duct Static Pressure hunting on Tuning trend: swinging ~1.1-2.1 in wc around 1.50 in wc setpoint, roughly hourly period, all day. Discharge Static Stpt description notes it was set to 1.5 per JWF ax 27 28 job - suspect loop was never retuned after that setpoint change. Supply Static Integral Time = 60 sec, Supply Fan Ramp Rate = 20%/min - both aggressive for this duct size, likely overshooting on every correction. Exhaust static (-0.973 vs -0.90 stpt) also close to its setpoint - possible SF/EF tracking conflict amplifying the swing. No active alarms yet (Supply 2 High Static Press Alarm and Exhaust 2 Low Static Press Alarm both Normal).

Cooling Valve Cmd/Position mismatch: Cmd reads 0% open but Position reads 99.7% open - valve appears stuck/failed open or feedback fault, opposite of commanded state. Discharge Air Temp 48.2F vs 55.0F setpoint (7F low) is consistent with the coil dumping full cooling regardless of command. Separate issue from the static pressure hunting - flagging for its own WO.
